verdict.line: You lose extended trades and solo-kill attempts before level 6, but you take the matchup overall at a 56.8% clip once Sunfire Aegis and Brittle start swinging skirmishes your way.

brief.thesis: Yorick's Q (Last Rites) resets every 6/5.5/5/4.5/4s and heals him on the next hit, so he wins prolonged trades and all-ins in the early levels where that cooldown outpaces your own. Ornn doesn't need to win lane; he needs to survive it, because his W (Bellows Breath) applying Brittle and his armor-stacking tank build eventually make Yorick's auto-attack damage irrelevant.

theirWindow.what: He heals off the next-hit bonus damage and can freely extend trades. Don't facetank autos here — back off, let him burn Q on a minion if he overextends, and reset the wave instead of matching hits.

yourWindow.what: The final gout of flame from W (Bellows Breath) applies Brittle. Immediately follow with Q (Volcanic Rupture) for the slow, then E (Searing Charge) off nearby terrain for the shockwave knockup before Brittle falls off.

start.why: 55.6% win rate over 586 games. The regen-on-hit and damage reduction against autos directly blunts Yorick's Last Rites poke and basic trading.

boots.why: 55.9% win rate over 744 games, 81.1% pick rate. Yorick's damage is entirely physical auto-attacks, so the flat reduction outvalues Mercury's Treads here.

core.why: The highest-performing path (64.3% over 42 games) starts here; its armor and AoE burn start outpacing Yorick's sustain once it's online.
Stacks armor directly against his physical damage and punishes his auto-attack reliant trading pattern.
Caps off the 64.3% win-rate path with resistances that scale Ornn's HP tankiness for extended skirmishes and objective fights.

situational.when: his Q (Last Rites) healing is getting out of hand in lane, rush this first in the Bramble Vest > Sunfire Aegis > Thornmail path (63.2% over 19 games)
the game shifts toward heavier magic damage, this alt core path hits 73.9% over 23 games
you need more sustain to survive prolonged skirmishes once his Maiden is active

runes.keystoneWhy: Sustains Ornn through Yorick's poke-heavy early trades and scales bonus health into damage and healing over the long lane patterns this matchup demands.

summoners.why: Flash+Teleport is run on 74.8% of games (55% win rate) and lets you reset after losing early skirmishes, then teleport back in to siege once your armor-stacking core comes online. Flash+Ignite (56.9% win rate, 21.9% pick) is a reasonable alt if you want to punish his overextensions before he hits 6.

playing.title: Trade only off cooldown
playing.detail: Only commit to an extended trade when your Q (Volcanic Rupture, 9-7s cd) and W (Bellows Breath, 12-10s cd) are both up; Yorick's Q resets so quickly (6-4s cd) that fighting without yours up loses.

playing.title: Chain off Brittle instantly
playing.detail: Once W lands Brittle, immediately follow with Q's slow and an E (Searing Charge) into terrain for the shockwave knockup before Brittle expires.

playing.title: Respect his E mark
playing.detail: Yorick's E (Mourning Mist) reduces your armor and marks you, giving his Mist Walkers bonus speed toward you. Disengage once marked rather than standing in it.

playing.title: Don't dash into his wall
playing.detail: W (Dark Procession) drops a destructible wall that can block your E (Searing Charge) path mid-dash. Check for a clear line before committing the charge.

playing.title: Force fights at Sunfire spike
playing.detail: Stop contesting hard trades 1-7; once Sunfire Aegis and boots are online around level 9-11, start initiating skirmishes instead of avoiding them.

playing.title: Redirect R onto him
playing.detail: After Call of the Forge God (R, 140-100s cd) is summoned, recast by charging into the elemental to redirect it onto Yorick for the knockup and reapplied Brittle, especially right after he's spent Q healing.

playing.title: Watch for his Maiden
playing.detail: His R (Eulogy of the Isles) summons the Maiden of the Mist, giving him bonus damage on her target in extended fights. Don't overstay sieges once his ultimate is active.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, and all win-rate/pick-rate figures are measured from current-patch OP.GG games; the mechanical reasoning and timing calls are my own read on why those numbers land the way they do.

stats.opponentTip: Yorick’s (P) makes him a difficult target. Be careful of his (E) and if his (P) charges in, use [W] to get rid of them easily. Yorick’s (R) gives him the upper hand in prolonged fights, so use [Q] and [W] to clear lane.
